minutes_text:
Parking and Traffic Commission Minutes
 February 27, 2019

  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION
  February 27, 2019 Meeting Minutes
  COMMISSIONERS  STAFF MEMBERS
  Michael Benbow  Chairperson  Peter Puglese, T.E., P.E., City Traffic Engineer
  Charles Braggs  Dist. 1  Joi Aldridge, Management Assistant
  Leonel Garcia  Dist. 2  Mario Inga, Interim Parking & Enterprise Services Manager
  Brett C.S. Roberts  Dist. 3  Lieutenant James Kirk

  I.  Roll Call of Commissioners and Call to Order by Chairperson
   Meeting called to order by Chairperson Benbow at 7:00 pm
   Commissioner Barbara Brooks did not attend meeting
  II.  Approval of Minutes for August Meeting
   Commissioner Leonel Garcia made the motion to accept the minutes
   Commissioner Charles Braggs seconded the motion
   Minutes approved 3-0
 III.  Public Comments (comments not listed on the agenda)
   Inglewood business resident came to discuss striping on 2nd Ave

 IV.  Unfinished Business: None
  V.  New Business:
   Report on Request for Establishment of District #18 (2nd, 3rd & 4th) - Peter Puglese,
  PE, TE, City Traffic Engineer- City Traffic Engineer read and explained report.
  Commissioner Braggs made a motion to table the item to a later date (May/June).
  Commissioner Roberts seconded the motion. Motion approved.

 VI.  Public Hearings: None
VII.  Resolutions: None
VIII.  Referral from City Council or City Departments: None
 IX.  Parking & Traffic Control: None

  X.  Police Department: None
 XI.  Commissioner Initiatives:
   Installation of traffic sign request on Pincay & 90th (see attached letter from residents
  of Renaissance) - City Traffic Engineer reviewed issue with Commission. 

XII.  Announcements:
   Next meeting is tentatively scheduled for March 27, 2019
XIII.  Adjournment: Meeting was adjourned at 7:58pm.
